title: Will my child need lifelong occupational therapy?
metaTitle: Durability of Occupational Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: The requirement for continued occupational therapy may vary for each child at Pinnacle Blooms Network. Regular assessments ensure the therapy course is most effective for the child's unique needs.
html: Every child's journey with Pinnacle Blooms Network is unique, with some children requiring a short duration, while others may benefit from ongoing sessions. A key part of our approach is regular assessments to track your child's progress and adjust the therapeutic plan accordingly, which helps us determine whether the child needs to continue therapy or is ready to manage everyday tasks efficiently on their own.
